---
description: Investigate one normalized security finding
agent: Security Reviewer
---

Use one finding ID. Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File .security/run-security.ps1 -Mode Finding -FindingId <id>` yourself, then load only the relevant manifest/code path/tests.

Classify the finding as Confirmed, Probable, Needs Investigation, or False Positive. Explain the evidence, attack path, impact, and uncertainty. Do not edit code.
